name: KG Intelligence CO.,LTD.
summary: KG Intelligence Co. Ltd., formed in 1950 with headquarters in Okayama, Japan, provides content and services across several sectors. Its recruitment offerings include the E-ARPA job site, Alpa magazine, job fairs and newspaper inserts. It also offers career counseling, job placement, recruitment and training support, and printing and binding for posters, leaflets and pamphlets.
